server_enabled.description: Whether to enable the EIBD-compatible server for client connections.

server_bind_address.description: IP address the server binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or a specific IP (e.g., '127.0.0.1').

server_client_port.description: TCP port used for legacy EIBD client connections.

tunnel_enabled.description: Whether to enable KNXnet/IP tunneling server (for tools like ETS or GUI clients).

tunnel_bind_address.description: IP address for KNXnet/IP tunneling. Typically same as server bind address.

tunnel_port.description: TCP port for KNXnet/IP tunneling (standard is 3671).

router_enabled.description: Whether to enable KNX router mode (required for KNX multicast routing across subnets).

bus_device.description: Device path for local interfaces (e.g., '/dev/ttyUSB0' for USB, '/dev/ttyS0' for serial). Ignored if bus_type is 'ip' or 'knxip'.

bus_remote.description: Hostname or IP address for remote IP connections (e.g., '192.168.1.50'). Required when bus_type is 'ip' or 'knxip'.

bus_local.description: Custom KNX individual address in 'a.b.c' format (e.g., '1.1.0'). Leave empty to auto-assign.

bus_baud.description: Baud rate for serial devices (e.g., TP-UART). Only used when bus_type is 'tpuarts'.

security_password_enabled.description: Enable password protection for server connections. Not recommended unless remote access is required.

security_password_hash.description: SHA-1 hashed password, generated using `knxd-passwd`. Format: 'sha1$<hexhash>'. Required if password protection is enabled.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (none) to 6 (trace). 4 = info (recommended for production).

log_file_path.description: Path to log file when log_destination='file'.

items.description: Group address to monitor (e.g., '1/2/3' or range '1/2/0-15').

monitor_groups.description: Optional list of KNX group addresses to monitor (for debugging or logging).
